title: Factory Equipment Perception & Digital Twin Real-Time Dashboard
description: Near real-time dashboard displaying factory cell pallet occupancy, transition events, and perception health from Microsoft Fabric Eventhouse

tiles.title: Occupancy Rate (%)
tiles.query: CurrentPalletOccupancy | summarize Rate = round(100.0 * countif(isOccupied == true) / count(), 1)

tiles.title: Digital Twin - Current Pallet Station Status
tiles.query: CurrentPalletOccupancy | join kind=leftouter (PalletPositions | join kind=inner Cells on cellId) on $left.subjectId == $right.palletPositionId | project Plant = plantName, Cell = cellName, Position = positionName, SubjectId = subjectId, Status = iff(isOccupied, 'Occupied', 'Empty'), Confidence = confidence, LastCaptured = capturedAt, Camera = sourceId | order by Cell asc

tiles.title: Live Pallet Transition Stream (Last 1 Hour)
tiles.query: ProcessEventsRaw | where observationType == 'PalletPresent' and capturedAt > ago(1h) | order by capturedAt desc | project Timestamp = capturedAt, Cell = subjectId, Action = iff(tobool(value) == true, 'Pallet Placed (Occupied)', 'Pallet Removed (Empty)'), Confidence = confidence, Model = model

tiles.title: Edge-to-Cloud Latency (Seconds)
tiles.query: ProcessEventsRaw | where capturedAt > ago(30m) | extend LatencySec = datetime_diff('second', ingestionTime, capturedAt) | summarize AvgLatency = avg(LatencySec) by bin(capturedAt, 1m)
